# Grassroots Kitchen + Creamery

> > Award-winning small-batch ice cream creamery and elevated street food restaurant with locations across Connecticut.

Grassroots Kitchen + Creamery is a Connecticut-based ice cream shop and casual restaurant founded in 2013, specializing in homemade small-batch ice cream flavors, scratch-made comfort food, and catering services. The brand operates multiple scoop shops in Granby, Simsbury, and New Milford while also distributing packaged pints through retail grocery stores.

## Key Topics

- Small-batch ice cream
- Dairy-free sorbet options
- Scratch-made comfort food
- Connecticut locations
- Ice cream flavors (Cookie Monster, Double Oreo, Goat Cheese Blackberry, Blood Orange Chocolate Chip)
- Catering services
- Online ordering
- Community support and nonprofits
- Allergen information
- Retail distribution
- Gift cards and merchandise
- Specialty flavors

## Menu & Products

- [Flavors](https://grassrootsicecream.com/flavors): Complete ice cream flavor catalog with dairy-free and specialty sorbet options
- [Food](https://grassrootsicecream.com/kitchen): Scratch-made comfort food menu with fried chicken, gyros, salads and Carolina BBQ

## Locations & Hours

- [Scoop Shops](https://grassrootsicecream.com/scoop-shops): Scoop shop locations across Connecticut with delivery and ordering options
- [Locations](https://grassrootsicecream.com/locations): Store locations in Granby, Simsbury and New Milford CT with hours and delivery
- [Find Us In Stores](https://grassrootsicecream.com/find-us-in-stores): Retail grocery store locations for packaged Grassroots Ice Cream pints

## Services & Events

- [Catering](https://grassrootsicecream.com/catering): Catering services for weddings, parties and corporate events with ice cream trailer
- [Shop](https://grassrootsicecream.com/online-store): Online merchandise store for apparel, stickers, totes and gift cards
